name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TLWE.linear_closure
title: Linear closure of trapdoor-decodable linear evaluations
statement: Let ct = t M + E be a row vector (all ciphertext LWE components, secret t, public M, hidden error E). If two public column operations L1, L2 send the secret part into the form of one fixed matrix A (M L1 = Q1 A and M L2 = Q2 A), then every combination a L1 + b L2 does too: ct (a L1 + b L2) = (t (a Q1 + b Q2)) A + E (a L1 + b L2). So the set of linear evaluations that a public trapdoor of A decodes (secret part in A-form, small error) is closed under short combinations; the trapdoor acts as a linear zero test on the hidden error.
